name: Sight Unbound
descriptionTemplate: Obtain [Power:Arg1] {STR}. Choose 1 card from the Draw Pile and add it to your hand, reducing its Arithmetica Cost by 1. {Loop}: Instead, choose 1 card from the Draw Pile or Discard Pile and add it to your hand, setting its Arithmetica Cost to 0.
lore:
These eyes can no longer see normally.
She faces the storm of time and reality, allowing the howling chaos to cut and shatter, ultimately becoming her eyes.
Another trace belonging to "Ramona" is disappearing from her body. She cannot grasp the self that is slipping away, just as she cannot hold onto the life flowing from her fingertips.
